messages:
serena: Rolling out release edge-warmup v2026.03.21 to eu-west1 now. Deploybot reported canary pass for core paths, starting staggered ramp.
deploybot: deploybot: canary -> promoted to staggered. smoke-check summary: 99/100 green, 1 probe failing (embed-route-prefill) in eu-west1-b. logs: `/var/log/smoke/1779456123.log`.
hank: saw the probe flapping ~13:12 UTC, p95 latency on embed-route jumped from 85ms -> 420ms, a couple of 5xxs. Noting KV warmup misses in that AZ.
maya: is this limited to the new model variant or the routing change? we toggled kv-prefill tweak in the node pool config.
jun: linking telemetry: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/embed/rel-1779?orgId=1
jun: query: `sum by(zone) (rate(smoke_probe_failures[5m]))` shows spike only in eu-west1-b.
oncall-robin: taking this. i'll run a targeted replay and disable prefill tweak for that AZ while we triage.
serena: ok, two options: 1) pin traffic for eu-west1 to previous revision (v2026.03.18) and continue rollout elsewhere, or 2) hotpatch the prefill heuristic to be more conservative for short sequences. thoughts?
hank: prefer pin + rollback for that AZ only. keeps global rollout moving and buys time. we should avoid global rollback unless it widens.
maya: +1 for AZ-pin. the prefill tweak might be safe but we need more perf traces before broadening.
deploybot: deploybot: action scheduled: pin-route(eu-west1-b) -> v2026.03.18, TTL 30m, reason: probe-failure-delta. runbook ref: /runbooks/smoke-pin.
oncall-robin: done, pinned eu-west1-b to v2026.03.18. running synthetic replay now, will report if failures persist.
jun: started replay job 1779456123-replay, sample set=embed-prefill-short. ETA ~5m.
oncall-robin: replay finished: no 5xxs on pinned revision, probe pass rate restored to baseline. KV warmup logs indicate higher cache misses on the new variant in that AZ (cold-starts), likely due to instance warmup timing.
serena: good. decision: keep eu-west1-b pinned for 1 hour while infra warms and we roll a corrective change (tweak warmup concurrency). will add to release notes: partial AZ pin and follow-up hotfix.
maya: i'll open a PR to revert the prefill tweak in the AZ-specific rollout config and prepare a hotfix that increases prefill backoff.
hank: will monitor p95 and error budget dashboards. if other AZs start to show noise, we revert full rollout.
serena: thanks all. summary: pinned eu-west1-b -> v2026.03.18 (deploybot), replay confirmed fix, follow-up hotfix PR from maya. stay on watch for next 60m. :eyes:
jun: added annotation to the release changelog and created incident-lite thread in incidents channel for tracking.
deploybot: deploybot: pin TTL expired? reminder scheduled at 1779459723 to verify rollback still desired.
